title: An Empirical Evaluation of Using ChatGPT to Summarize Disputes for Recommending Similar Labor and Employment Cases in Chinese
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of Large Language Models (specifically ChatGPT, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4) to summarize legal disputes for case recommendation in the labor law domain. It does not contain any component evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
